Hi Taylor —

Thanks again for your time over the phone last week. Wed like to move you to a condensed virtual full-loop for the Senior Infrastructure SWE role. The interview is a ~3.5 hour compact agenda (three back-to-back slots + 30m break) with a short debrief at the end.

Options (PST):
- Wed Mar 10 — 10:00am start (10:00–1:30, 30m break at 11:30)
- Thu Mar 11 — 1:00pm start (1:00–4:30, 30m break at 2:30)

If either works, Ill send a calendar invite and the short agenda. We try to keep the sequence as: system design -> coding + debugging exercise -> leadership/behavioral + hiring manager wrap.

Note: agenda (condensed-loop-agenda-v1.pdf) attached; Ive included Vivek (recruiter) and Laura (hiring manager) on CC in case we need to adjust panel order for availability. Let me know any accessibility needs or time constraints.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference

Jasmine —

Thanks for the heads up. For this role Id prefer we swap the order to: coding exercise first (so were fresh), then system design, then hiring manager + team fit. Two reasons: 1) we want to see problem-solving raw, without priming from a long design discussion; 2) the final slot is where Id like to do deeper org/context and compensation questions.

Also request: please put the 30m break after the first two slots (so candidates get a breather before the HM slot). Example revised cadence for a 3.5h window starting at 10:00 PST:
- 10:00–10:55 coding (Marcus)
- 11:00–11:55 system design (panel: Laura + 1 eng)
- 12:00–12:30 break / lunch buffer
- 12:30–1:15 hiring manager + org (Laura)
- 1:15–1:30 quick internal buffer/debrief

Ive flagged Marcus for the coding slot, Vivek can coordinate logistics. If Taylor prefers midday start, we can shift.

- Laura
VP Eng, Platform
